author: 92gaming
quote: I played the classic in 99, my first full Zelda game that got me addicted to the franchise to this day. The adaptation is as perfect as a remaster can be, content added to make it more fun. Amazing graphics music and voice acting. Didn’t experience any bugs and the game was completely smooth. I’ll be playing this for the rest of the year no doubt.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
